title: Verify and wire ApprovalDetailModal approve/reject actions
description:
ApprovalsPage references ApprovalDetailModal for viewing approval details and taking action. Verify the modal has working approve/reject buttons wired to backend mutations.

**Implementation:**
- Read `dashboard/src/components/approvals/ApprovalDetailModal.tsx`
- Verify it calls `useApproveJob()` and `useRejectJob()` mutations
- If mutations are missing, add them using `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/approve` and `POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/reject`
- Verify the modal shows: job details, safety decision reason, policy rule reference, approve/reject buttons with loading state
- Add confirmation step before reject (optional reason textarea)

**Files:** `dashboard/src/components/approvals/ApprovalDetailModal.tsx`, `dashboard/src/hooks/useJobs.ts` (if mutations missing)
definitionOfDone: Approve button calls backend and updates UI
Reject button calls backend with optional reason
Modal closes on success and list refreshes
